div.head: VIII Atr 12.1
div.ab: ⁊ leohtgescot gelæste man to candelmæssan; dó oftor se ðe wille.
⁊ leohtgescot gelæste man to candelmæssan; dó oftor se ðe wille.
And leohtgescot gelæste man to candelmæssan; do oftor se ðe wille.
Und Lichtschoss werde zu Lichtmess [2. Febr.] entrichtet; thu es öfter wer will.
And let light-dues be paid at Candlemas [2 February]; let whoever wishes pay it more often.
And light-dues shall be rendered at Candlemas; he who so desires may give them more frequently.
And the dues for the lighting of the church are to be paid by Candlemas, but may be rendered more often if one wishes.

Cf. E. and G. 6, 2, where no set time is mentioned; V Atr. 11, 1; VI, 19; Wulfstan, pp. 116, 208, where light-dues are demanded three times a year; I Cn. 12, where the fixed times are given as Candlemas, Easter and All Hallows; Wulfstan, p. 311, where Christmas is substituted for All Hallows.
